about: David M. Caldevilla is an attorney who represents clients in the Tampa, Florida area. David Caldevilla is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Caldevilla chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Florida State University College of Law and graduated in 1986. David Caldevilla passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1987.
He represents clients with Appellate issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Civil Litigation: Plaintiff, Consumer Law and Insurance Coverage issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Caldevilla has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
